extraction_rules: Source: cas_to_english records from wave3_smoke_20260507T232622Z.jsonl joined to seeds.jsonl by sample_id.source_id == seed.seed_id.
Pythia input: the natural-English description in the wave3 record's 'raw_response' field (the model-generated paraphrase of the seed CAS).
Label: seed.axes.noetics_used[0], which is one of 0..9.

Filter — single noetic only: seed.axes.noetics_used must have length exactly 1. Records with 0 noetics (e.g. domain-only expressions) or multiple noetics (compound expressions) are excluded for the v1 single-label probe.

Filter — compiler-validated SEED: seed.compiler_validated must be True. Note: the wave3 cas_to_english record's own compiler_validated field is always None (it produces English, not CAS, so there is nothing to compile). The validity check rides on the seed expression.
Filter — no leakage: wave3 record's leakage_in_reply must be False (CAS notation did not bleed into the English description).
Filter — non-empty english: raw_response must be a non-empty string after stripping whitespace.
Filter — minimum length: raw_response must be at least 20 characters after stripping (rejects empty / trivial / one-word responses).
Random selection: NONE. The script is deterministic; full set of eligible records is emitted in the order they appear in the wave3 source.
guardrails: This snapshot is research-only, used ONLY by code under noetic-compass-scaffold/noetic-compass/research/cas_probe/.
Pythia weights and any probe artifacts derived from this snapshot must never enter the production CAS Native stack.
